```{r Import}

                         show_col_types = F)

M6_A0 <- haven::read_sas("../../data_hors_git/raw_data/gb_ddb_id_01_qv_06_test.sas7bdat")
```

# Corriger données d'identité

```{r M6_A0 to M6_A2}

# Ajouter id_doublon
M6_A1 <- M6_A0 %>%
  left_join(
    M1_A3 %>% 
      select(id_anonymat:id_keep),
    by = "id_anonymat"
  ) %>% 
  relocate(id_doublon:id_keep, .after = id_anonymat) %>% 
  select(-id_sep, -id_type, -tab_db) %>% 
  haven::zap_label() %>% 
  haven::zap_formats() %>% 
  mutate(across(
    .cols = where(is.character),
    .fns = ~ na_if(., "")
  )) %>% 
  mutate(
    id_prenom = replace_when(
      id_prenom,
      id_prenom == "NA" ~ "NAA"
    )
  )

# Remplir les données manquantes de l'identité

M6_A2 <- M6_A1 %>% 
  rows_patch(
    M1_A3 %>% 
      select(any_of(colnames(M6_A1))),
    by = "id_anonymat",
    unmatched = "ignore"
  ) %>% 
  select(-(qv_type:id_age_cat_3))
```

# Identifier absents

```{r}

vars_check <- M6_B0 %>%
  select(qv_sa_etat:qv_am_rac_pour_autre) %>%
  names()

M6_B1 <- M6_B0 %>%
  mutate(
    absent = if_all(all_of(vars_check), is.na),
    .after = id_anonymat
  ) %>% 
  
  # Identifier ceux qui ont participé au module
  mutate(
    qv_complet = case_when(
      absent ~ 0L,
      !absent ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ -99L
    ),
    .after = id_anonymat
  ) %>% 
  select(-absent)

```

# Retirer doublons

```{r M6_B1 to M6_C0}

# Identifier les doublons
doublons <- M6_B1 %>% 
  group_by(id_keep) %>% 
  filter(n() > 1) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  relocate(c("id_doublon", "id_keep"), .after = id_anonymat)

# Corriger les données d'identité issues du questionnaire

doublons_corr <- doublons %>%
  mutate(
    id_anonymat = id_keep
  ) %>% 
  filter(qv_complet == 1)

# Joindre les données propres
M6_C0 <- M6_B1 %>% 
  filter_out(id_keep %in% doublons$id_keep) %>% 
  bind_rows(doublons_corr) %>% 
  arrange(id_anonymat)

```

# Recoder les NAs

## Modalités de réponse

```{r}

rcd_simple_1 <- function(df, vars, complet){
  df %>% 
    mutate(
      across(
        {{vars}},
        ~ (case_when(
          !is.na(.) ~ .,
          is.na(.) & {{complet}} == 1 ~ -9,
          is.na(.) & {{complet}} == 0 ~ -2,
          TRUE ~ -999
        ))
      )
    )
}

rcd_borne_bin <- function(df, borne, vars){
  df %>% 
    mutate(
      across(
        {{vars}},
        ~ case_when(
          !is.na(.) ~ .,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == 1 ~ -9,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == -2 ~ -2,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == -9 ~ -9,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == 0 ~ -1,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == -1 ~ -1,
          TRUE ~ -999
        )
      )
    )
}

rcd_borne_opt1 <- function(df, borne, x, out, vars){
  df %>% 
    mutate(
      across(
        {{vars}},
        ~ case_when(
          !is.na(.) ~ .,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == x ~ -9,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == -2 ~ -2,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == -9 ~ -9,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == -1 ~ -1,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} %in% {{out}} ~ -1,
        )
      )
    )
}

```

```{r}

rcd_qcm_borne <- function(df, borne, vars){
  df %>%
    mutate(
      all_na_vars = if_all({{vars}}, is.na)
    ) %>% 
    mutate(
      across(
        {{vars}},
        ~ (case_when(
          !is.na(.) ~ .,
          {{borne}} == -2 ~ -2,
          {{borne}} == 0 & all_na_vars ~ -1,
          {{borne}} == 1 & all_na_vars ~ -9,
          {{borne}} == -9 & all_na_vars ~ -9,
          {{borne}} == 1 & is.na(.x) ~ 0,
          TRUE ~ -999                           
        ))
      )
    ) %>%
    select(-all_na_vars)
}
```


```{r M6_C0 to M6_C1}

quest_simples <- M6_C0 %>% 
  select(qv_sa_etat:qv_ad_besoin, qv_sc_travailleur:qv_am_regime,
         qv_am_complement, qv_am_ald:qv_am_rac) %>% 
  colnames()

QV5 <- M6_C0 %>% 
  select(qv_ad_act01:qv_ad_act999) %>% 
  colnames()

out_V7 <- c(2, 3)

QV18 <- M6_C0 %>% 
  select(qv_am_type_1:qv_am_type_999) %>% 
  colnames()

QV22 <- M6_C0 %>% 
  select(qv_am_rac_pour_1:qv_am_rac_pour_999) %>% 
  colnames()

M6_C1 <- M6_C0 %>% 
  rcd_simple_1(all_of(quest_simples), qv_complet) %>% 
  
  # Corriger à la main pcq option dans le questionnaire pour jsp et ne pas répondre
  # donc lui remettre notre codification
  mutate(
    qv_sa_etat = replace_when(
      qv_sa_etat,
      qv_sa_etat == 99 ~ -8,
      qv_sa_etat == 88 ~ -9
    )
  ) %>% 
  rcd_borne_bin(qv_ad_besoin, qv_ad_type) %>%
  rcd_borne_opt1(qv_ad_type, 1, out_V7, qv_ad_lien) %>% 
  rcd_qcm_borne(qv_ad_besoin, all_of(QV5)) %>% 
  rcd_qcm_borne(qv_am_complement, all_of(QV18)) %>% 
  mutate(
    qv_am_rac = replace_when(
      qv_am_rac,
      qv_am_rac == 0 & qv_am_rac_montant > 0 ~ 1
    )
  ) %>% 
  rcd_borne_bin(qv_am_rac, qv_am_rac_montant) %>% 
  rcd_qcm_borne(qv_am_rac, all_of(QV22))

rm(list = c("quest_simples", "QV18", "QV22", "QV5", "vars_check"))
rm(list = c("doublons", "doublons_corr", "M1_A3", "M6_A0", "M6_A1", "M6_A2",
            "M6_B0", "M6_B1", "M6_C0", "add_qv", "out_V7", "rcd_borne_bin",
            "rcd_borne_opt1", "rcd_qcm_borne", "rcd_simple_1"))

```

## Réponses textuelles

```{r}

rcd_texte_qcm <- function(df, borne, reponse){
  df %>% 
    mutate(
      {{reponse}} := case_when(
        !is.na({{reponse}}) ~ {{reponse}},
        {{borne}} == 1 & is.na({{reponse}}) ~ "-9",
        {{borne}} == 0 & is.na({{reponse}}) ~ "-1",
        {{borne}} == -2 & is.na({{reponse}}) ~ "-2",
        {{borne}} == -9 & is.na({{reponse}}) ~ "-9",
        {{borne}} == -1 & is.na({{reponse}}) ~ "-1",
        TRUE ~ "-999"
      )
    )
}

rcd_texte_autre <- function(df, borne, reponse){
  df %>% 
    mutate(
      {{reponse}} := case_when(
        !is.na({{reponse}}) ~ {{reponse}},
        {{borne}} == 999 & is.na({{reponse}}) ~ "-9",
        {{borne}} == -2 & is.na({{reponse}}) ~ "-2",
        {{borne}} == -9 & is.na({{reponse}}) ~ "-9",
        {{borne}} == -1 & is.na({{reponse}}) ~ "-1",
        {{borne}} >= 0 & {{borne}} <= 90 & is.na({{reponse}}) ~ "-1",
        TRUE ~ "-999"
      )
    )
}


```

```{r M6_C1 to M6_C2}

M6_C2 <- M6_C1 %>% 
  rcd_texte_qcm(qv_ad_act999, qv_ad_act_autre) %>% 
  select(-qv_ad_lien_autre) %>% 
  rcd_texte_autre(qv_am_regime, qv_am_regime_autre) %>% 
  rcd_texte_qcm(qv_am_type_999, qv_am_type_autre) %>% 
  rcd_texte_qcm(qv_am_rac_pour_999, qv_am_rac_pour_autre)

```

## Traduire réponses libres
Y revenir à 17h20
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)


# 2. Valeurs uniques, non vides, sur les 6 variables à la fois
textes_uniques <- M6_D0 %>%
  select(all_of(vars_libres)) %>%
  unlist(use.names = FALSE) %>%
  unique() %>%
  discard(~ is.na(.x) || trimws(.x) == "")

fichier_dico <- "dico_QDV_traduction.rds"

# Reprend là où on s'était arrêté, si une sauvegarde existe
dico <- if (file.exists(fichier_dico)) readRDS(fichier_dico) else character(0)

traduire <- function(x, essais = 5) {
  for (i in seq_len(essais)) {
    res <- tryCatch(
      google_translate(x, target_language = "en",
                                 source_language = "fr"),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (length(res) == 1 && !is.na(res)) return(res)
    attente <- 10 * 2^(i - 1)  # 10 s, 20 s, 40 s, 80 s, 160 s
    message("Échec, nouvel essai dans ", attente, " s...")
    Sys.sleep(attente)
  }
  NA_character_
}

a_traduire <- setdiff(textes_uniques, names(dico))

for (i in seq_along(a_traduire)) {
  txt <- a_traduire[i]
  dico[txt] <- traduire(txt)
  Sys.sleep(1)  # pause entre chaque requête
  if (i %% 20 == 0) {
    saveRDS(dico, fichier_dico)
    message(i, " / ", length(a_traduire), " traduits")
  }
}
saveRDS(dico, fichier_dico)

# 4. Application aux 6 colonnes


M6_D1 <- M6_D0 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(vars_libres),
                ~ unname(dico[.x]),
                .names = "{.col}_en"))

for (v in vars_libres) {
  M6_D1 <- relocate(M6_D1, all_of(paste0(v, "_en")), .after = all_of(v))
}

readr::write_csv(M6_D1, "/Users/alicethomassin/Muco 2026/data_hors_git/process_data/thoa_M6_D1_eng.csv")
```
